image_process.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Add a single tiny prehistoric pigment motif on previously bare rock at x=800..910, y=1020..1060 in this 1254-square cave painting: two distinct small worn red ochre pebble dots with a very short charcoal dash between them and a tiny chalk tick above each. They represent preserving a very small separation. Keep the addition sparse and hand drawn. Preserve ALL existing paintings and Pepe, every old mark, rough warm rock texture, roots, cracks, torchlight, square size and framing unchanged. Earth pigments only. Do not add hands or handprints. No text, letters, numbers, captions, signatures, logos, watermark, border, frame, photography, 3D, real people or political symbols. Save generated output at artifacts/line-3/wall-v20.png if possible.
image_process.method: Generated edit retained only inside empty-rock patch with a seven-pixel internal edge blend. All other decoded pixels restored from exact ancestor. Donor replaced by final wall; no extra image retained.
